longDefinition: The disorder is characterized by signs and symptoms of the early stage of disease include improper sleeps, loss of digestion, pallor of the body and edema particularly around the eyelids, pain in the mouth and the legs, excessive circulation of blood leading to the increased speed of the veins and their getting hot and stuck, dryness of the skin.
